notes: A refutation, and a useful one, because three separate Huawei surfaces still advertise this: the students page, the Brazil region page, and a support FAQ last updated in 2022. The pattern is the classic stale-index trap the brief names. Huawei International signup itself is genuinely email-first: email address, then a mobile number, then a credit card, per its own account guide. If a free package were still issued on registration the identity cost would be email, which is why the dead page matters. A third-party review asserts the 2026 list contained only management and security services (Auto Scaling, DNS, Anti-DDoS, IAM, CTS, AOM, SWR, RFS, SMS, Cloud Eye) and no ECS, EVS or OBS; that is reported, not confirmed, because the page is gone and the archive capture offered is from 2025-09.
